messages:
alex_sales: Quick question — Boreal Labs POC needs an intercompany invoice routed. Procurement says signature routing needs clarification: they want one legal signature but billing from Redwood EU entity. Who should sign the order form? DPA has EU controller addendum redlines. @maria_legal @sam_finance any blockers for e-sign across entities? Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/example-orderform.pdf

maria_legal: We need to confirm which Redwood legal entity is the contract counterparty. If billing is from the EU entity, the Order Form should reference that entity and be countersigned by their authorized signer. DPA redlines look OK but we need KYC for Boreal's EU legal entity. Did they return the LOA?

alex_sales: They sent LOA for Boreal Labs SL (attached). They want quick turnaround — POC kicks off next week. Is it acceptable to have MSA signed by Redwood US and invoice from Redwood EU?

maria_legal: Not ideal — that creates a contract/billing mismatch. Two options: 1) Have MSA + Order Form executed by the same Redwood entity (preferred), or 2) add a short addendum clarifying billing entity and cross-entity indemnities. Option 2 needs finance sign-off. @sam_finance?

sam_finance: If billing is Redwood EU then payments must wire to our EU account and we need EU VAT handling. Finance will need the invoice to show EU VAT reg no and PO line items. For fast go-live we can accept Billing=EU while MSA=US only if Finance accepts the addendum. Also confirm currency — EUR or USD?

ivy_solutions: For a small POC we can also do a hosted trial credit instead of a formal invoice to avoid cross-entity paperwork, but I know their procurement insists on an invoice. Pricing tier is standard for POC. @alex_sales did Boreal list tax jurisdiction?

alex_sales: They listed "Boreal Labs SL, Spain" — VAT ESB12345678. Currency: EUR. LOA attached. Timeline: need signed docs by Thursday EOD.

maria_legal: OK — I'll update the Order Form to reference Redwood Inference EU LLC and draft a short addendum linking the MSA to the OF so the signer liability is clear. I'll circulate a redline in #legal-drafts in 30m. If Finance signs off on EUR wiring, we can proceed.

sam_finance: EU wiring details — please confirm payer and PO reference before we finalize. Also we prefer net30 for POCs unless procurement requests otherwise.

alex_sales: Sending wiring details to them and will ask for PO. invoice-bot create provisional invoice #INV-20241089 for EUR 12,000 (POC credit). :thumbsup:

invoice-bot: invoice-bot: Invoice #INV-20241089 created (status: draft). Link: https://invoices.redwood.internal/INV-20241089

maria_legal: One more note — include "Electronic signatures are binding" clause on the OF so wet-ink is not required, and ensure the DPA signature block references the same entity name. I'll ping @ops-signing for the e-sign flow and an audit trail.

sam_finance: Confirming net30 and VAT applied. Once fully executed, treasury will schedule the wire. Treasury needs the order form executed by Thu 18:00 UTC to hit month-end close.

alex_sales: On it. I'll push the updated OF + addendum to Boreal now and route for signature. Thanks all!
